# Atlas Changelog

Fixture in the shape of the Atlas changelog markdown. Headings changed format in 2026.

## 2026 Releases

### October 2026

- Adds user settings to the Atlas UI Data Explorer. To learn more, see [Atlas UI User Settings.](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-ui/#std-label-data-explorer-settings)
- Adds support for Google Cloud Pub/Sub as a sink in Atlas Stream Processing, allowing you to stream data with GCP Private Service Connect for private network connectivity.

### September 2026

- Public Preview: Releases Atlas Infinite, an Atlas database edition that separates compute from storage. To learn more, see [MongoDB Atlas Infinite: Overview.](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/infinite/atlas-infinite-landing/#std-label-atlas-infinite-edition)
- General Availability: Adds [Intelligent Workload Management](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/intelligent-workload-management/#std-label-intelligent-workload-management), which protects cluster availability during overload.
- Public Preview: Adds support for the `$rerank` operator in Atlas Search, enabling semantic re-ranking of search results to improve relevance.
- Adds additional metrics to the third-party DataDog integration, including database and namespace-level metrics for enhanced observability.
- Removes the option to enable the BI Connector for new and existing clusters ahead of its end of life. To query your data with SQL, use [Atlas SQL](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/sql-interface/) instead.
- Publishes the [end-of-life plan](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/push-logs/#std-label-pble-eol) for Push-Based Log Export, which reaches end of life on February 4, 2027.

#### Sub-section inside a release

- Adds a nested item that still belongs to the September 2026 release. See [Docs](/docs/atlas/backup/cloud-backup/overview/#std-label-backup-cloud-provider).

## 2025 Releases

### 10 December 2025 Release

- Supports deploying clusters in additional regions:

  - AWS: ap-southeast-7
  - Google Cloud: me-central2

- Adds *Query Shape Insights* to the Atlas UI. See [Query Shape Insights](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights/).

### 05 December 2025 Release

- Adds Query Shape Insights for sharded clusters. See [Query Shape Insights](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights/).
